items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: John Coliani, the pianist did a trio with Duffy Jackson, and the three of us. That was funny. That was a funny experience, I mean just being on the road with Duffy was something right there.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’ve been doing Europe two or three times a year, either with Bob Wilber, or I went over with Frank Vignola, the guitarist, he did a little Django group there a little over a year ago, and who else — John Coliani, the pianist did a trio with Duffy Jackson, and the three of us. That was funny. That was a funny experience, I mean just being on the road with Duffy was something right there.
